snippet.title: Cat on the Jungle Path
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #CatOnTheJunglePath
🇧🇷🇵🇹
🐱 Prepare-se para uma aventura selvagem em Cat on the Jungle Path!
Assuma o volante do jipe de José, o Gato, e percorra trilhas desafiadoras em meio à natureza. Enfrente gêiseres perigosos, caminhos frágeis e puzzles inteligentes enquanto planeja cada movimento e controla a velocidade para chegar ao destino!

🎮 Disponível a partir de 5 de novembro no Xbox, com 20% de desconto no lançamento!

🇺🇸🇬🇧
🐱 Get ready for a wild adventure in Cat on the Jungle Path!
Take the wheel of José the Cat's jeep and navigate challenging wilderness trails. Face dangerous geysers, fragile paths, and clever puzzles as you plan every move and control your speed to reach the destination!

🎮 Available starting November 5 on Xbox, with a 20% launch discount!

KEY FEATURES
🐱 Build your route and race through dangerous jungle trails;
🐱 Master jeep speed to dodge geysers and fragile paths;
🐱 Explore 30 strategic levels across three wild biomes;

Grab Yours 
🎮 Xbox One: https://x.gd/jpNd4
🎮 Xbox Series: https://x.gd/P2rVsd
🎮 Windows: https://x.gd/VVBnY
